meaning: to pass along, transmit (objects, information, feelings)

senses.en: to pass along, transmit (objects, information, feelings)

note: 传递 is passing something along; 传达 is conveying a message or instruction.

examples.zh: 请把这张表传递给后面的人。
examples.en: Please pass this form to the person behind.

examples.zh: 声音可以通过空气传递。
examples.en: Sound can travel through the air.

examples.zh: 手机让我们能快速传递信息。
examples.en: Phones let us pass information quickly.

meaning: to give financial support; financial aid

senses.en: to give financial support; financial aid

examples.zh: 公司资助了他的学费。
examples.en: The company paid his tuition.

examples.zh: 谁资助你出国留学？
examples.en: Who is funding your study abroad?

examples.zh: 这个研究得到了政府的资助。
examples.en: This study received government funding.

note: Often 比以往 (than before) or 和以往不同.

examples.zh: 今年的价格比以往高。
examples.en: This year's price is higher than before.

examples.zh: 以往我每天骑车上班。
examples.en: In the past I cycled to work every day.

examples.zh: 和以往不同，他今天很安静。
examples.en: Unlike usual, he is very quiet today.

meaning: to take priority; to give priority

senses.en: to take priority; to give priority

examples.zh: 老人和孩子可以优先上车。
examples.en: Elderly people and children may board first.

examples.zh: 这件事要优先处理。
examples.en: This matter must be dealt with first.

examples.zh: 你觉得哪件事应该优先？
examples.en: Which thing do you think should come first?

meaning: to avoid, evade, dodge (a person or issue)

senses.en: to avoid, evade, dodge (a person or issue)

examples.zh: 别回避问题，我们谈谈吧。
examples.en: Don't dodge the issue; let's talk.

examples.zh: 她一提这件事，他就回避。
examples.en: Whenever she brings this up, he avoids it.

examples.zh: 你为什么回避我的眼睛？
examples.en: Why are you avoiding my eyes?

examples.zh: 夏天的桃又大又甜。
examples.en: Summer peaches are big and sweet.

examples.zh: 我想买几个桃。
examples.en: I'd like to buy a few peaches.

examples.zh: 这个桃还没熟，有点儿酸。
examples.en: This peach isn't ripe yet; it's a bit sour.

meaning: to look, appear (a certain way); to show

senses.en: to look, appear (a certain way); to show

note: Colloquial 显 + adjective: makes someone or something look young, tall, old.

examples.zh: 这件衣服显年轻。
examples.en: This garment makes you look young.

examples.zh: 他穿西装显高。
examples.en: He looks tall in a suit.

examples.zh: 这个颜色显老，别买了。
examples.en: This color makes you look old; don't buy it.

note: Also figurative: 点燃热情 (spark enthusiasm).

examples.zh: 他划了一根火柴，点燃了火。
examples.en: He struck a match and lit the fire.

examples.zh: 这场比赛点燃了大家的热情。
examples.en: This match fired everyone's enthusiasm.

examples.zh: 别在森林里点燃火，很危险。
examples.en: Don't light a fire in the forest; it's dangerous.

note: Placed before the verb: 紧紧抱着, 紧紧跟着.

examples.zh: 孩子紧紧抱着妈妈。
examples.en: The child hugged his mother tightly.

examples.zh: 请紧紧抓住我的手。
examples.en: Please hold my hand tight.

examples.zh: 他紧紧跟着导游，怕迷路。
examples.en: He stayed close to the guide for fear of getting lost.

examples.zh: 她的态度很坚定。
examples.en: Her attitude is very firm.

examples.zh: 我坚定地相信他会成功。
examples.en: I firmly believe he will succeed.

examples.zh: 你要坚定自己的想法，别轻易放弃。
examples.en: Stand by your own ideas; don't give up easily.

meaning: complexion; the look on one's face

senses.en: complexion; the look on one's face

note: Describes health (脸色不好) or mood (脸色难看).

examples.zh: 你的脸色不太好，哪里不舒服吗？
examples.en: You look pale; are you feeling unwell?

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，他的脸色变了。
examples.en: Hearing the news, his expression changed.

examples.zh: 老板脸色很难看，你小心一点。
examples.en: The boss looks upset; be careful.

meaning: a stringed or keyboard instrument; piano, zither

senses.en: a stringed or keyboard instrument; piano, zither

note: Mostly in compounds: 钢琴, 小提琴; alone with 弹/拉/练.

examples.zh: 她从小就喜欢弹琴。
examples.en: She has liked playing the instrument since childhood.

examples.zh: 我家隔壁有人在练琴。
examples.en: Someone next door is practicing an instrument.

examples.zh: 他的手受伤了，不能弹琴了。
examples.en: His hand is hurt, so he can't play anymore.

examples.zh: 请看看这个数目对不对。
examples.en: Please check whether this figure is right.

examples.zh: 这笔钱的数目不小。
examples.en: This is not a small sum of money.

examples.zh: 参加的人数目比去年多。
examples.en: More people took part than last year.

note: 月亮 is the moon you see at night; 月球 is the moon as a body.

examples.zh: 月球离地球很远。
examples.en: The moon is far from the Earth.

examples.zh: 你想去月球旅游吗？
examples.en: Would you like to travel to the moon?

examples.zh: 人类已经登上过月球。
examples.en: Humans have already landed on the moon.

examples.zh: 这间屋子光线很好。
examples.en: This room has good light.

examples.zh: 光线太暗，拍不出好照片。
examples.en: The light is too dim to take good photos.

examples.zh: 一道光线从窗户照进来。
examples.en: A beam of light shines in through the window.

note: Close to 仍然 and 还是; slightly written.

examples.zh: 过了很多年，他仍旧住在老房子里。
examples.en: Many years later, he still lives in the old house.

examples.zh: 雨停了，天仍旧很冷。
examples.en: The rain stopped, but it is still cold.

examples.zh: 我劝了他好几次，他仍旧不同意。
examples.en: I urged him several times, but he still disagrees.

note: Spoken form is 肩膀; 肩 appears in compounds.

examples.zh: 我的肩有点儿疼，想休息一下。
examples.en: My shoulder aches a bit; I want to rest.

examples.zh: 他拍了拍我的肩，说加油。
examples.en: He patted my shoulder and said, "Keep going."

examples.zh: 她的头靠在我的肩上。
examples.en: Her head rested on my shoulder.

examples.zh: 照片拍得有点儿模糊。
examples.en: The photo came out a bit blurry.

examples.zh: 我对那件事的印象很模糊。
examples.en: My memory of that matter is vague.

examples.zh: 没有眼镜，我看什么都模糊。
examples.en: Without glasses, everything looks blurry to me.

meaning: to carry, have (a quality or element)

senses.en: to carry, have (a quality or element)

note: Followed by an abstract noun: 带有……色彩 / 意思.

examples.zh: 他的话带有批评的意思。
examples.en: His words carry a hint of criticism.

examples.zh: 他的声音带有一点紧张。
examples.en: His voice has a touch of nervousness.

examples.zh: 这张表带有公司的标志。
examples.en: This form carries the company logo.

note: Read jiàn; as in 键盘 (keyboard).

examples.zh: 请按这个键。
examples.en: Please press this key.

examples.zh: 我的键盘有一个键坏了。
examples.en: One key on my keyboard is broken.

examples.zh: 钢琴的键很多。
examples.en: A piano has a lot of keys.
